text:
Rep. Morgan McGarvey criticizes Trump’s Iran policy and economic record in new social media posts
Rep. Morgan McGarvey posted several critical statements about former President Donald Trump’s foreign policy decisions and domestic economic impacts on October 20-21, 2026.
Rep. Morgan McGarvey, U.S. Congressman representing Kentucky’s 3rd district since 2023, used his social media platform to criticize former President Donald Trump’s recent actions and policies in a series of posts published on October 20 and 21, 2026.
On October 20, McGarvey addressed the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran, stating, "235 days and over $40 billion on Trump's war with Iran, and not even his top officials know how to end it. No one is safer, and all of us are paying for it."
The following day, McGarvey commented on Trump’s promises regarding veterans’ compensation, "Yet another promise for something he should have been doing for the last 2 years. Fair compensation for vets and their families is not dependent on a vote for Trump's allies. Don't believe his lies. If he actually wanted to help veterans, we could do it today." This post was made on October 21.
Later that same day, McGarvey criticized Trump’s economic policies, writing, "Since day 1 Trump has only been looking out for himself and his donors. This year, most families will pay $1,700 more for gas, groceries, and taxes. Trump and his friends in the top 1% will actually pay LESS — $12,560 less."
Morgan McGarvey has served as the representative of Kentucky's 3rd District since replacing John Yarmuth in 2023. Prior to his tenure in Congress, he served in both the Kentucky House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023 and the Kentucky Senate from 2013 to 2023. Born in Louisville in 1979, McGarvey holds a BA from the University of Missouri and a JD from the University of Kentucky College of Law.
